scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,black "npm run dev -w @chat/api" "npm run dev -w @chat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chat/api && npm run build -w @chat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chat/api && npm run typecheck -w @chat/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chat/api && npm run test -w @chat/web
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run test:watch -w @chat/api" "npm run test:watch -w @chat/web"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @chat/api && npm run test:coverage -w @chat/web
